title: Deliver exact restricted symbolic IR rational bridge through controlled RED GREEN and package-only consumer
commitMessage: feat: add exact restricted symbolic IR cancellation with pole-preserving consumer

contribution.summary: Qualify M4-W01-C02-T1 through one real compiled missing-contract RED, 25 independent GREEN tests and eight NuGet-only consumer oracles. Deliver dw.tools.math.symbolics 0.5.0-preview.1 with a closed, provider-free real exact rule (x²-c²)/(x-c) => restricted(x+c,x!=c) and typed point refusals. Lock the new projects, inspect three local NuGet artifacts and record actual SHA-256s. Satisfy EXT-SYMBOLIC only from bounded C01 provider evidence while leaving C02-T2 unstarted.
contribution.value: Provide an independently consumable typed Math symbolic primitive that cannot silently fill a removed singularity, without making Angouri or a broker a production dependency.
debtChanges: One compiled reflection RED demonstrates the new public typed symbolic cancellation API is missing from a real empty project before production implementation is installed.
Twenty-five independent semantic GREEN tests cover exact and fractional poles, variable identity, conflicting assumptions, bounded operands, canonical IR restrictions and no implicit approximation.
Eight source-independent oracles execute through a local NuGet-only .NET 10 client with a closed external feed, direct symbolics package reference and transitive IR/quantities dependencies.
A separate C# post-packaging inspector records actual archive identities and SHA-256s for dw.quantities, dw.tools.math.ir and new dw.tools.math.symbolics without recalculating DWF authority hashes.
New lowercase .NET product/test projects, explicit lockfiles and solution membership are staged with complete controlled mutation paths, then checked through locked restore/build and relevant tests.
EXT-SYMBOLIC becomes satisfied only for C01's documented bounded provider-selection and process-limit evidence, not general Angouri deployment or conditional text-to-IR adoption.
C02-T1 R/G/V and T1 reach done while C02, M4-W01 and M4 remain in progress; T2 and C03 stay unstarted, with no public feed, provider integration or AURA/dw.discovery broker claims.
contribution.nextAction: After durable RS055 success, independently qualify M4-W01-C02-T2 provider-condition rejection, assumption transport, invalid IR/domain boundaries and consumer compatibility before closing C02.

Deliver and qualify the narrow M4-W01-C02-T1 typed symbolic IR product contract, controlled RED/GREEN evidence and independent local package consumer without implying C02 or M4 completion.
